title: The connector wire carries remote provenance from its first version: man...
content: The connector wire carries remote provenance from its first version: manifest entries include remote_id, remote_version, and a renderable remote URL as metadata, so evidence can cite the source document rather than a logical path.
rationale: The wire is greenfield now and the design's own framing settles it ("a wire version bump: cheap once, expensive twice"). Evidence citation is a program goal (M3/M9 and record-to-source citation), logical paths are not stable identity across renames, and the satellite holds all three fields at observation time so carriage is nearly free. Operator ratified 2026-08-13.
